functions.name: central_function
functions.description: Global per-cohort Beta and M values (sample-weighted across nodes) of chosen probes or of the top probes by difference between cohorts

arguments.name: cohort_column
arguments.description: Name of the column in each node's data that holds the cohort of each sample. Results are computed per cohort.

arguments.name: min_samples
arguments.description: Minimum number of samples a cohort needs on a node to be included in that node's result. Cohorts below this threshold are dropped on the node.

arguments.name: probes
arguments.description: CpG probes to report, at most 10,000 (e.g. cg00000029; a CpG name also selects its EPIC v2 replicates such as cg00000029_TC21). Leave empty for the top probes.

arguments.name: top_n
arguments.description: Without a probe list: report this many probes (1-10,000) with the largest difference in mean Beta between cohorts (delta_beta).

functions.name: federated_function
functions.description: Per-cohort mean Beta and M values of the given probes on a node

arguments.name: cohort_column
arguments.description: Name of the column in each node's data that holds the cohort of each sample. Results are computed per cohort.

arguments.name: min_samples
arguments.description: Minimum number of samples a cohort needs on a node to be included in that node's result. Cohorts below this threshold are dropped on the node.

arguments.name: probes
arguments.description: CpG probes to summarise, at most 20,000 (required).

functions.name: federated_top_probes
functions.description: IDs of a node's probes with the largest difference in mean Beta between its cohorts (used by central_function)

arguments.name: cohort_column
arguments.description: Name of the column in each node's data that holds the cohort of each sample. Results are computed per cohort.

arguments.name: min_samples
arguments.description: Minimum number of samples a cohort needs on a node to be included in that node's result. Cohorts below this threshold are dropped on the node.

arguments.name: top_n
arguments.description: Without a probe list: report this many probes (1-10,000) with the largest difference in mean Beta between cohorts (delta_beta).
